revision_note: r4: read the chanter cluster export. RED_TIME emptied — 9 and 22 are always BLACK (110/2155) so never reached the red-only klasma test, and 23 is always RED (759) and is the Ga martyria LETTER, so it was the sole source of a phantom "red klasma". Cluster 9 (antikenoma+apli) moved to MARK_ONLY and now contributes its one apli beat. ALSO fixed a long-standing off-by-one: the DTW duration prior compared onset-to-onset time against beats of units j2+1..j instead of j2..j-1 — invisible while all beats were 1.0/2.0, material once the duration model produced 0.125..4.0. Rests now fold into the PRECEDING note (chanter: "otherwise the next note will go on for too long instead of being delayed the duration of the rest").

vs_gold.strict_on_pins_note: ingest_pins.py builds the expected delta from iv_ovr_<hymn>.json, the chanter's own interval rulings, so the reported 0.787 partly scores his answers as if they were model predictions. Unassisted (legend only) is 0.760, a gap of 2 of 75 pairs today. The gap grows mechanically as corrections are compiled, so the UNASSISTED number is the primary one.

note: The segmentation fix alone moved median |dt| 4.10 -> 0.563 s and coverage 58.7 -> 71.1%. A large excursion remains around units 3-19 (up to -5.8 s): the aligner still has no absolute-time anchor and cannot re-sync once it slips.
